text: {"resumen":"Multiple failed logons (8+) for user scastro from ADMIN-LAPTOP (192.168.56.1) to the domain controller within 30 seconds of a password change, with no successful logon following. The pattern matches a known benign scenario: stale cached credentials after password reset.","razonamiento":"The alert triggers rule 100200 (brute force, 8+ failures from one source). However, the raw_log shows scastro changed their own password at 09:02:11 (EventID 4723), followed immediately by regular 30-second retry intervals with sub-status 0xc000006a (credential mismatch). This matches exactly the documented benign pattern for ADMIN-LAPTOP: mapped drives or saved credentials with stale cached passwords after a user password change.
